# Track 2: Domain Science Bachelor Track

This track is intended for students who enter the RSE Master with a **Bachelor in a domain
subject** — natural sciences and technology (MNT), social sciences (SoWi), the humanities (HuWi),
and related fields. These students first acquire the computer-science and software-engineering
foundations they are missing, then deepen the computational methods of their own domain alongside
the RSE-specific competencies.

The curriculum follows the six competency areas (*Bereiche*) of Table 5.1 of the curricular
recommendations. The table below reproduces that structure — including its colour coding — with the
ECTS that apply to Track 2.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

**\*** If students already acquired programming skills in their domain Bachelor, they may replace
the Computer Science foundations (up to 18 ECTS) with elective Software Engineering courses
(Requirements Engineering, Software Architecture, Software Testing; up to 12 ECTS) or other
advanced courses. Universities may also make some of these courses mandatory prerequisites
(*Auflagen*). The Computer Science / Software Engineering block sums to 18 ECTS in total for this
track.

:::
